mahjong.title: Play Mahjong Online for Free: A Classic Tile Game
mahjong.slogan: Experience the timeless fun of Mahjong!
mahjong.description: Discover the captivating world of Mahjong, a beloved tile-based game originating from China. Enjoy hours of strategic gameplay and cultural richness. Play Mahjong online now and test your skills!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Mahjong, also known as Mahjongg, is a traditional Chinese tile-based game that has gained popularity worldwide.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: The tiles are shuffled and arranged in a square formation.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Each player draws a certain number of tiles to start the game.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: The goal is to form specific combinations of tiles.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Form melds (groups of three or four tiles) and pairs.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Requires skills in observation, calculation, and decision-making.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Reflects Chinese culture and traditional values.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Often played among family members and friends.
